== Summary ==
Identified: [[Angelo Consoli]] (dark graphic tee, glasses, khaki pants, on his phone) and [[Enno Haede]] (back to the camera; grey hair and a black stormtrooper shirt with his name/mark, matching [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]). A man in a dark shirt with glasses at the window table, a man in a maroon shirt at the far table (same face as the black jacket in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]), and a man with dark hair at the far table are not all named here; the maroon-shirt man remains unlabeled, and the far-table player in the black tee is [[Quirin Fürgut]] (same face and beard as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 14.jpg]]).

Main event at the 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK, 3 June 2023, hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date:''' 3 June 2023
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-06-03
* '''Identification:''' [[Angelo Consoli]] (dark graphic tee, glasses, khaki pants, on his phone) and [[Enno Haede]] (back to the camera; grey hair and a black stormtrooper shirt with his name/mark, matching [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]). A man in a dark shirt with glasses at the window table, a man in a maroon shirt at the far table (same face as the black jacket in [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 8.jpg]]), and a man with dark hair at the far table are not all named here; the maroon-shirt man remains unlabeled, and the far-table player in the black tee is [[Quirin Fürgut]] (same face and beard as [[:File:2023 Naboo Regionals 14.jpg]]).
